verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official MCP server (trivy-mcp) enabling natural-language querying of scan results, which is a foundation for AI-driven triage/explanation of findings, and this was verified hands-on (JSON-RPC handshake succeeded). However, there is no documented capability for deduplicating findings or automatically flagging false positives — the MCP server's stated feature is just natural-language Q&A about issues, not structured triage logic. Missing for 10: explicit deduplication of duplicate findings across scans, false-positive flagging/suppression guidance via AI, and any hands-on demonstration of the MCP server actually explaining or triaging a set of findings.
